in-member-s-world-talk-to-in-a-non-leagu.npc: I'm an Assistant to the Sage. If you have any questions about Leagues, I can help you out.
Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?
Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?

steps.player: What's a League?

steps.npc: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!

steps.player: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

steps.npc: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.npc: My pleasure!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts.
This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Demonic Pacts that let you choose new combat effects and improvements.
As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
You can also collect powerful artefacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
One Relic allows you to harvest the souls of the slain, and another gives you the power to fell trees with your bare hands!
Of course, there are many other Relics to choose from.
One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it!

steps.text: To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

options.text: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.npc: Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.

options.text: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.player: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.npc: Of course! What would you like to know?

steps.player: How do League Trophies work?

steps.npc: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.

options.text: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.

steps.player: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.

options.text: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?

steps.player: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?

steps.npc: Which League do you want to know about?

steps.player: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.

steps.npc: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 2,500 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 5,000 points. The Steel Trophy cut- off is 10,000 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 18,000 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 28,000 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 42,000 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,000 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Trailblazer Reloaded League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Trailblazer Reloaded Trophies.

steps.text: If the player earned more than 2500 in the Trailblazer Reloaded League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded. That makes you eligible for the Trailblazer Reloaded [type] Trophy and all Trailblazer Reloaded Trophies under it!

steps.player: Leagues III: Shattered Relics.

steps.npc: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 480 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 1,660 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 5,475 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 15,575 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 31,980 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 52,545 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Shattered Relics League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues III: Shattered Relics. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Shattered Relics Trophies.

steps.text: If the player earned more than 100 in the Shattered Relics League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues III: Shattered Relics. That makes you eligible for the Shattered Relics [type] Trophy and all Shattered Relics Trophies under it!

steps.player: Leagues II: Trailblazer.

steps.npc: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 510 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 2,000 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 6,480 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 18,720 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 35,680 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,310 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Trailblazer League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues II: Trailblazer. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Trailblazer Trophies.

steps.text: If the player earned more than 100 in the Trailblazer League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues II - Trailblazer. That makes you eligible for the Trailblazer [type] Trophy and all Trailblazer Trophies under it!

steps.player: Leagues I: Twisted.

steps.npc: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 10 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 80 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 510 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 20,830 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues I: Twisted. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Twisted Trophies.

steps.text: If the player has earned more than 10 points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues I - Twisted. That makes you eligible for the Twisted [type] Trophy and all Twisted Trophies under it!

options.text: Actually, let's talk about something else.
Actually, let's talk about something else.

steps.player: Actually, let's talk about something else.

steps.npc: Very well.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.npc: All the best.

steps.player: I'm good, thanks.

steps.npc: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
